item.description:
Nexa 1.0.7

  • The chat list keeps a sensible width: it opens wide enough to read names, and can no longer be dragged so wide that the chat gets squeezed and its buttons disappear into a "»" menu.
  • Showing the sidebar again no longer makes the window wider each time.
  • Nexa remembers its window size and chat list width after updates.
  • Fixed a rare crash in how chats are saved.
